date.as_written: śaptāṃkaśaptaści sa śākavarṣe nabhaḥkṛṣṇaśivā ca tithyau || yamārkṣayoge śrutvaṃ ca candravāre

notes: The chronogram reads 'śaptāṃkaśaptaści [śaśi]' (sapta-aṅka-sapta-śaśi = 7, 9, 7, 1 reversed: Śaka 1797 = 1875 CE). Ādinātha in the text attribution (mahākālasaṃhitā) is mythical/divine and not included. Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa refers to a deity/temple ('in front of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa').
